title: A Choir for the Smile
author: Marguerite Zhou
blurb: Ivo Blackwood, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
